Subject: Discovery follow-up + technical deep-dive slots

Hi Lucas / Hannah —

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful context on your ingestion pipeline and data residency constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: primary use case is in-product summarization of provider notes; target latency < 200ms for synchronous flows and batch embeddings for analytics.
- Open items: SSO integration (SAML/OKTA), SOC 2 evidence, procurement form and PO cadence.

To keep momentum, can we lock a technical deep-dive where our platform engineering partner (Karthik) can walk through SSO, KV cache handling, and deployment options? Proposed 45–60m slots (all times PT):

1) Wed 21 Sep — 9:00–10:00 AM PT
2) Wed 21 Sep — 2:00–3:00 PM PT
3) Thu 22 Sep — 11:00–12:00 PM PT

Please reply with the best slot and add any internal stakeholders from security/procurement who should join. If you prefer, we can do two shorter sessions (platform + procurement separately).

Also attaching a draft agenda (technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf) and an ASAP SOC 2 answers doc — we can follow up with the full SOC report under NDA if needed. If you have a procurement checklist or PO template, please drop it here and I’ll loop legal.

Best,
